Gene Ontology (GO) enrichment analysis for differential expression results

rna_enrich.Rd

Performs Gene Ontology (GO) enrichment analysis on differentially expressed genes derived from rna_compare(), using the clusterProfiler framework. Enrichment is computed separately for up- and down-regulated genes, allowing directional biological interpretation.

The function automatically retrieves the selected comparison from the active rna_project, applies filtering based on adjusted p-values and log2 fold-change thresholds, maps gene identifiers, and computes enrichment across one or more ontology domains (BP, MF, CC).

Usage

rna_enrich(
  project,
  plot_style = c("dotplot", "barplot"),
  ont = c("BP", "MF", "CC"),
  enrich_p_cutoff = 0.1,
  padj_cutoff = 0.05,
  log2fc_cutoff = 0.5,
  plot = TRUE,
  top_terms = 10,
  save = TRUE
)

Arguments

project

rna_project object created by rna_project().

plot_style

Character. Wheter use barplot or dotplot.

ont

Character vector. Ontology domains to test:

  • "BP": Biological Process

  • "MF": Molecular Function

  • "CC": Cellular Component

enrich_p_cutoff

Numeric. P-value cutoff used internally by clusterProfiler::enrichGO() to filter enriched GO terms (default: 0.1).

padj_cutoff

Numeric. Adjusted p-value threshold used to filter differentially expressed genes prior to enrichment (default: 0.05).

log2fc_cutoff

Numeric. Absolute log2 fold-change threshold used to define up- and down-regulated genes (default: 0.5).

plot

Logical. Whether to display dot plots of enriched GO terms (default: TRUE).

top_terms

Integer. Number of top enriched terms to display in plots (default: 10).

save

Logical. Whether to store results in the active rna_project (default: TRUE).

Value

An object of class "enrich_result" containing:

contrast

Group contrast (test vs reference)

organism

Organism used for annotation

gene_id_type

Gene identifier type used in enrichment

up

Named list of enrichment results for up-regulated genes (per ontology)

down

Named list of enrichment results for down-regulated genes (per ontology)

params

List of parameters used in the analysis

Details

The function performs the following steps:

  1. Retrieves differential expression results from rna_project

  2. Filters genes using padj_cutoff and log2fc_cutoff

  3. Splits genes into up- and down-regulated sets

  4. Performs GO enrichment separately for each set and ontology

  5. Optionally visualizes results using dot plots

Gene identifiers are automatically interpreted using the project metadata (gene_id_type) and passed to clusterProfiler::enrichGO().

Supported annotation databases:

  • Human: org.Hs.eg.db

  • Mouse: org.Mm.eg.db

  • Zebrafish: org.Dr.eg.db

Important:

  • Gene IDs must be cleaned (no Ensembl version suffixes)

  • Enrichment depends strongly on filtering thresholds

  • Up- and down-regulated enrichments may reveal distinct biology

Stored output

When save = TRUE, results are stored in: rna_project$analyses$enrich, allowing reproducibility and reuse.

Visualization

When plot = TRUE, dot plots are generated using enrichplot::dotplot(), showing the top enriched GO terms per ontology and direction (up/down).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Run enrichment using last comparison
rna_enrich(project = my_project)

# Run enrichment with stricter thresholds
rna_enrich(my_project,
           padj_cutoff = 0.01,
           log2fc_cutoff = 1)

# Run enrichment for molecular function
rna_enrich(my_project,
           ont = "MF")
} # }
